Balances.description: Which balance-sheet amounts the ratios use (SPEC-0007 R2). No default: the analyst chooses.

oneOf.description: Balances at the end of the period (`closing`).
Average of the opening and closing balances: (opening + closing) / 2. Needs `opening`.

DebtPeriod.description: One period of the loan schedule.

cfads.description:
Cash flow available for debt service in the period, in currency units. Absent or null:
not given; the DSCR of the period, the present value of CFADS and the LLCR are not
computed.

debt_service.description:
Debt service (principal and interest) due in the period, in currency units. Absent or
null: not given; the DSCR of the period is not computed.

DebtSchedule.description: The loan schedule from the calculation date to the final maturity.

debt_outstanding.description:
Debt outstanding at the start of the first period, in currency units. Absent or null:
not given; the LLCR is not computed.

discount_rate.description:
Discount rate for the LLCR: the cost of debt per period of the schedule chosen by the
analyst, as a decimal fraction (0.06 = 6% per period). Absent or null: not given; the
present value of CFADS and the LLCR are not computed.

periods.description: Periods 1..n, in order, up to the final maturity of the loan. At least one.

reserve_balance.description:
Balance of the debt service reserve account at the valuation date, in currency units,
added undiscounted to the LLCR numerator. Absent: no reserve account.

net_financial_position.description:
Net financial position with its composition, in currency units. Absent or null: not
given.

DebtServiceIncome.description:
Flows of the period, in currency units. Every amount is optional: absent or null means not
given, and the ratios that need it are not computed (never taken as zero).

ebit.description: EBIT (operating result) of the period, in currency units.

ebitda.description:
EBITDA of the period, in currency units, as defined in `ebitda_definition` (the ratios
on EBITDA need both).

interest.description:
Interest expense of the period, in currency units, as defined in `interest_definition`
(gross, or net of interest income); the interest covers need both.

NfpComposition.description:
The net financial position of a `ratios.*` input, with its composition (SPEC-0007 R6).
Fairmark adds what is given and does not choose which items are included. Every amount is
optional (R7): without gross debt or cash the net financial position is not computed, never
taken as zero.

cash.description:
Cash and cash equivalents, in currency units, subtracted from the gross debt. Absent or
null: not given.

gross_debt.description:
Gross financial debt (bank loans, bonds and other borrowings), in currency units. Absent
or null: not given.

other_items.description:
Other items included by the analyst, each added with its sign. Default: none (an empty
list), as in version 1.

NfpOtherItem.description:
One item of the net financial position of a `ratios.*` input, other than gross debt and
cash.

amount.description:
Amount in currency units, added to the net financial position: positive for debt-like
items, negative for financial assets. Absent or null: not given, and the net financial
position is not computed.

name.description: What the item is, for example "lease liabilities" or "derivative assets".

description:
Input of `ratios.debt_service` (version 2). Only `balances` is required; each ratio is
computed when its own amounts are given (SPEC-0007 R7).

balances.description: Balances used by the ratios: `closing`, or `average` of opening and closing.

closing.description: Balance sheet at the end of the period. Absent or null: no amount given.

debt_schedule.description:
Loan schedule for DSCR and LLCR. Absent: DSCR and LLCR are not defined and the other
ratios are computed.

income_statement.description: Flows of the period. Absent or null: no flow given.

interest_definition.description:
How interest was measured, in words (for example "gross interest expense" or "interest
expense net of interest income"); echoed in the conventions. Absent or null: the interest
covers are not computed; given blank: refused.

opening.description:
Balance sheet at the start of the period, used with average balances; not used with
closing balances. Absent with average balances: the net financial position is not
computed.

title: DebtServiceInput
